# 1. Project Overview

ProjectPress is a modular WordPress project-management plugin developed by TrilB.Dev.

Its purpose is to provide:

- Central project creation and management.
- Individual project workspaces.
- Project teams, members and permissions.
- Tasks, milestones, discussions, notes, files and activity records.
- Project categories, tags, types, statuses and priorities.
- Administrative settings and global project-management configuration.
- REST API access for supported ProjectPress resources.
- Extensibility through the existing internal and external plugin systems.

ProjectPress is built from the existing TrilB.Dev WordPress plugin template. Development must extend the existing architecture rather than replacing it with an unrelated framework or parallel implementation.
